contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop, directed this production and commissioned the modernized Asteroids game.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed and implemented the deterministic fixed-step engine (inertia, splitting rocks, wrap-around field, drones, mega-rock, combos, dash), the retro-1950s cream/tomato/mint rendering, the trilingual interface (EN/FR/ES), the synthesized audio and the test suites. v1.1.0: power-up drops (triple fire, shield, slow rocks, extra life), hit-stop, interpolation, pop fragmentation, floating scores, combo stickers, animated sun and badges; verified the published game in the public reader.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: Reviewed the v1.0.0 rules wording and the v1.1.0 fun pass: recommended hit-stop, universal easing and an animated score, designed the instantly readable power-up badges (silhouette first), and warned against visual saturation hiding gameplay; suggestions applied by Z Code.
